newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern urges rejection of deal.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern urges rejection of deal.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp urged shareholders of Conrail Inc to reject a key provision in the proposed merger between Conrail and CSX Corp.
"By rejecting the proposed 'opt out' of Pennsylvania's fair value statute they can send a clear message to Conrail's board that CSX's latest bid is unacceptable...," it said.
Norfolk Southern, which earlier lost an effort in U.S. district court to thwart the proposed union, reaffirmed its commitment to buy Conrail.
Conrail shareholders are being asked to waive a Pennsylvania law that would essentially require CSX to pay cash for Conrail. CSX has proposed a cash and stock transaction.
"Regardless of the outcome of our appeal, Conrail shareholders will have an opportunity on January 17 to regain control of the corporation they own," Norfolk Southern said.
